mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in housing starts and retail sales, measured as both HOUST and RSAFS exceeding their 3-month moving averages, indicates robust consumer demand that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production below its 6-month moving average signals a manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 12-month annualized inflation rate exceeding 3.0% as measured by CPIAUCSL signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL 12-mo change exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls, as measured by PAYEMS, indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS is rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 500 thousand units signals a contraction in the housing sector, which typically reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST falls below 500, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.0% as measured by GDPC1 indicates robust economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
